name: Grade 7 IIIT Summative: Spreadsheets
description: Ten core third-trimester words for the Grade 7 spreadsheet vocabulary table.

words.definition: A tool that organizes information in rows and columns.
words.example: The student used a spreadsheet to organize survey results.

words.definition: One page or tab in a spreadsheet file.
words.example: The first sheet stored the class data, and the second sheet showed the chart.
Each row recorded one student's survey answer.
The column labeled Score contained every group's points.
The student typed the total in the highlighted cell.

words.definition: The name of a cell, such as A1.
words.example: The formula used the cell reference B2 to add the first value.

words.definition: A rule that calculates a value.
words.example: The formula calculated the total number of recycled items.

words.definition: A built-in formula tool, such as AVERAGE.
words.example: The SUM function added all the numbers in the column.

words.definition: A number found by adding values and dividing by how many values there are.
words.example: The class found the average score for the spreadsheet challenge.

words.definition: A visual way to show data.
words.example: The chart made the survey results easier to compare.
